title: 第2章 女人的往事

content_zh:
虽然老道脸色很自然，但是心里也在打鼓，这女人丈夫有丧事，还是喜丧？这也太扯淡吧？
中国人对喜丧的定义可是很严苛，只有死者超过了八十岁，并且是寿终正寝，不受疾病折磨，儿女满堂，才算得上喜丧，这女人看面相也就三十来岁的少妇，怎么他老公死了竟然是喜丧？
老道此时心中也愤愤，现在的自己，可是实打实的骗子行径！这不是自己的错，实在是化妆品太坑爹，哦不，太坑老道了，不过这样也不是办法，徒弟有多少斤两老道明白，看个大概可以，你要说让展步再往详细里说，只怕他还真做不来。
女人再想问话，这时候展步伸手止住了女人：“夫人不忙早作询问，我们这一脉有个规矩，凡是求卦问卜，必须要净面上香，拜过祖师爷才能开口，夫人请先随我洗把脸。”
老道忍不住暗赞一声，这徒弟虽然不着调，但是还蛮聪明的，知道进退，随即老道也打了个哈哈：“不错，夫人先洗把脸吧。”
展步引着这女人洗完脸，再看这女人的脸，连展步都忍不住同情师傅了，怪不得师傅相面屡屡碰壁。这女人虽然不丑，但是与刚才相比可以说是天壤之别，一个小小的洗脸盆就像是一个时光机，推进去的时候是个仪态万千的少妇，拉出来转眼就成了大妈……
展步也没多说话，引着她来到祖师爷雕像面前拜了几拜，上了几柱香，展步知道，老道肯定已经看出了端倪。
这个时候，展步贼兮兮的偷看了一眼老道，然后一本正经的告退：“师傅，那我先出去了。”
老道把展步一手养大，这小子一撅腚，老道就知道他要拉什么屎，怎么可能猜不透展步的心思，想偷懒？没门！
老道面色不变，一本正经的说道：“不用出去，你是我徒弟，这相术以后还要靠你传承下去，别的乌七八糟的东西始终上不了正堂，你就在这看着，也好跟着为师学两手。”
那女人以为是展步要回避自己的隐私，也急忙摆手道：“对，小师傅不用见外，我的事也不是什么私密的事情，没事。”
小师傅？展步心中一阵恶寒，自己明明是一现代五好阳光大帅哥好不好？就这张脸，拿出去分分钟秒杀什么偶像明星什么都教授好不好？你哪里看我像个小师傅了？
当然，师傅有命，不得不尊，不过想让自己放弃相胸术这个伟大是事业，那也是没门！
“那大师看我究竟是为什么而来啊？”这女人依旧忘不了考较老道。
这个时候，老道已经心有成竹，他知道，这女人一定还是有些疑虑，必须要拿出点真本事，才能把这女人镇住。
老道慢悠悠的说道：“夫人是为财而来，这个财，不是发财，而是为了守财。”
这时候，明显可以看到这女人神色一动，显然说中了她的心事，她也没心思再拿什么架子，急忙说道：“那以大师看，这财能守住吗？”
“呵呵，看你的面相，这是一个难过的坎，难啊……”老道摇摇头，一脸的唏嘘叹息。
这女人神色当即一黯，原本充满希望的表情一下子僵在脸上。
展步鼻观口，口观心，这路数，展步见的多了去了，先让你绝望，再给你希望，呵呵，老家伙最爱玩的手段。

果然，这老道微微沉思，然后低声说道：“也不是不可能……”
这女人一下子像是抓住了救命稻草一样：“大师教我！”
老道说道：“也罢，你能找到这里也算有缘法，既然求到我这里，我就不能坐视不理，不过你还是要先把事情的经过完整的说一下，我虽然能看出个大概，但具体什么事情，那不可能一下子看的透彻。”
真正懂面相的人，最多也就能看出一个人最近的运势如何，以及未来的命运走向，至于说一眼能看出你具体正在遭遇什么，那不可能。
这女人说道：“是这样，我老公年轻时赚了不少钱，但是生性风流，谁知道竟然在外面留下了几个野种，本来也没什么事，可是我老公刚刚去世，就有人跳出来要夺我的家产，而且还不止一个，一下子跳出了两男两女，都说自己是我老公的亲生子女……”
听到这里，老道脸色一寒：“夫人，如果您故意隐瞒，或者歪曲一些事实的话，那么这事就不要说了，神仙也难救。”

content_en:
Although the old man's face was very natural, he was also thinking in his heart. Is this woman's husband in mourning, or is he happy? Isn’t this too nonsense?
The Chinese have a very strict definition of joyful mourning. Only when the deceased is over eighty years old, has passed away, is not suffering from disease, and has a full house of children can it be considered a joyful mourning. This woman looks like a young woman in her thirties. How come her husband's death is actually a joyful mourning?
The old Taoist was also angry at this time. He was now a real liar! This is not my fault, the cosmetics are really too deceptive, oh no, they are too deceptive, but this is not the way. The apprentice knows how much he has, and it is enough to take a rough look. If you ask Zhan Bu to go into details, I'm afraid he really can't do it.
The woman wanted to ask again, but at this time she stretched out her hand to stop her: "Madam, don't be too busy to ask earlier. There is a rule in our lineage. Anyone who asks for divination must clean his face and pay homage to the ancestor before he can speak. Madam, please wash your face with me first."
The old Taoist couldn't help but secretly praise him. Although this apprentice was unconventional, he was quite smart and knew how to advance and retreat. Then the old Taoist also laughed: "That's right. Madam, please wash your face first."
Zhan Bu led the woman to wash her face. Looking at the woman's face again, even Zhan Bu couldn't help but sympathize with the master. No wonder the master always met with obstacles. Although this woman is not ugly, she can be said to be completely different from before. A small washbasin is like a time machine. When you push it in, you will be a well-mannered young woman. When you pull it out, you will become an aunt in the blink of an eye...
Zhan Bu didn't say much. He led her to the statue of the ancestor and bowed a few times and offered a few sticks of incense. Zhan Bu knew that the old Taoist must have seen the clues.
At this time, Zhan Bu took a sneak peek at the old man, and then excused himself seriously: "Master, I'll go out first."
The old Taoist raised Zhan Bu single-handedly. As soon as the boy raised his butt, the old Taoist knew what he was going to do. How could he not guess Zhan Bu's thoughts and want to be lazy? No way!
The old Taoist's face remained unchanged, and he said seriously: "You don't need to go out, you are my apprentice, and I will rely on you to pass on this physiognomy in the future. Other nonsense will never make it to the main hall. You can just watch here, so you can learn from my teacher."
The woman thought Zhanbu was trying to avoid her privacy, so she hurriedly waved her hand and said, "Yes, young master, you don't need to see anyone outside. My affairs are not private, so it's okay."
Little master? Zhan Bu felt a chill in his heart. He is obviously a modern and sunny handsome guy, okay? Just use this face to kill idols and stars in seconds and teach everything, okay? Why do you think I look like a little master?
Of course, the master has a destiny and must be respected, but there is no way to give up the great career of breast chest surgery!
"Then Master, why do you think I'm here?" This woman still couldn't forget to test her skills.
At this time, the old Taoist had already made up his mind. He knew that this woman must still have some doubts, and he had to show some real skills to calm this woman.
The old Taoist said slowly: "Madam is here for wealth. This wealth is not to make money, but to keep it."
At this time, it was obvious that the woman's expression changed, and it was clear that what she was thinking was right. She didn't want to put on any airs, and said hurriedly: "Master, can I keep this wealth?"
"Haha, looking at your face, this is a difficult hurdle. It's so difficult..." The old Taoist shook his head and sighed with a sigh on his face.
The woman's expression immediately darkened, and the originally hopeful expression suddenly froze on her face.
Zhan Bu looks at his mouth with his nose, and looks at his heart with his mouth. Zhan Bu has seen this method many times. He will first make you despair, and then give you hope. Haha, this is the old guy's favorite trick.
Sure enough, the veteran thought for a moment, then whispered: "It's not impossible..."
This woman suddenly seemed to have grasped a life-saving straw.Same: "Master teach me!"
The old Taoist said: "Well, you are destined to find this place. Since you have come to me, I can't just sit back and ignore it. However, you still have to tell the whole story first. Although I can see the general outline, it is impossible to see the specific things at once."
A person who really understands facial features can at best tell a person's recent fortune and future destiny. As for being able to tell what exactly you are encountering at a glance, that is impossible.
The woman said: "It's like this. My husband made a lot of money when he was young, but he was a romantic by nature. Who knew he would leave a few bastards outside? It was fine. But just after my husband passed away, someone jumped out to take away my property, and there were more than one. Two men and two women suddenly appeared, and they all said that they were my husband's biological children..."
Hearing this, the old Taoist's face turned cold: "Madam, if you deliberately conceal or distort some facts, then don't talk about it, even gods can't save you."
